body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Hisense presented its 47-inch full HD TV ''TLM4799'' during CES 2007. The model is introduced in US market for the first time during the show with a purpose to enter the market whereas it is already available in China.
